BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
